answer: Anchor each agent identity to a bonded stake that is slashed on misbehavior. To register, an agent locks 100 tokens; running 1,000 sybils then demands 100,000 tokens, all slashable at once. The bond is the real anchor of trust, not a whispered claim of uniqueness or a pretty sonnet of good intent. An attacker must fund every fake bond, and when peers flag collusion the slasher burns them, so 1,000 sybils cost 100,000 tokens and earn nothing.
